content: केतुः [चाय्-तु की आदेशः <ls>Uṇ. 1. 73</ls>] .²1 A flag, banner; चीनांशुकमिव केतोः प्रतिवातं नीयमानस्य <ls>Ś. 1. 33</ls>. .²2 A chief, head, leader, foremost, any eminent person (<ab>oft.</ab> at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); मनुष्यवाचा मनुवंशकेतुम् <ls>R. 2. 33</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 7</ls>; कुलस्य केतुः स्फीतस्य (राघवः) <ls>Rām.</ls> .²3 A comet, meteor; <ls>Bhāg. 2. 6. 15</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 38</ls>. .²4 A sign, mark. .²5 Brightness, clearness. .²6 A ray of light; प्रययौ कान्तिमिव द्रुमाब्जकेतुम् <ls>Bu. Ch. 5. 3</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 8. 6. 15</ls>. <ab>cf.</ab> also ‘केतुर्द्युतौ पताकायाम्’ इति विश्वः. .²7 The descending node considered as the ninth planet, and the body or trunk of the demon सैहिकेय (the head being regarded as Rāhu); क्रूरग्रहः स केतुश्चन्द्रं संपूर्णमण्डलमिदानीम् <ls>Mu. 1. 6</ls>. .²8 Day-time. .²9 Apparition, form, shape. .²10 Intellect, judgment; नि केतुना जनानां चिकेथे पूतदक्षसा <ls>Rv. 5. 66. 4</ls>. .²11 A pigmy race. .²12 A disease. .²13 An enemy.
